RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 15%

An all-female panel is not evidence of bias; civil service panels are typically determined by grade, role, and availability. Both you and the appointed candidate have strong credentials, and her international project experience may have aligned more closely with the ministry's specific strategic needs.

Additionally, a two-week wait for formal written feedback is a standard administrative turnaround in government, not an indication of bad faith. Alleging sex discrimination without concrete evidence of procedural unfairness will significantly harm your professional reputation.

Do not raise the panel’s gender. Instead, send a polite follow-up on your feedback request, focusing strictly on competency scoring to gain constructive insights for future promotion opportunities.
